name: Colorchips New Media Limited
about: Colorchips New Media Limited engages in the film production, exploitation, and distribution business in India. The company distributes and exploits contents in various formats, including cinema, digital, home entertainment, and television syndication.It also offers YouTube and digital marketing; web and mobile app development; ecommerce; and RFID implementation services. The company was formerly known as Millitoons Entertainment Limited and changed its name to Colorchips New Media Limited in October 2018. Colorchips New Media Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Visakhapatnam, India.
